Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    varShowSubmitErrors &&
    FacilitiesServiceSubcategoryDropdown_1.Selected.Value = "Building Maintenance" &&
    IsBlank(FacilitiesRequestTypeDropdown_1.Selected.Value),
    "Request Type is required.",
    Parent.Error
)

Switch(
    FacilitiesParkingLocationDropdown_1.Selected.Value,
    "Civic Center",
    "Civic Center parking is paid and has a waiting list. Your request will be reviewed.",
    "Other parking locations (free)",
    "Parking at this location is free. You do not need to submit a request. No further action is necessary.",
    ""
)
"The requested file could not be downloaded."

Set(varShowSubmitErrors, true);

If(
    IsBlank(DataCardValue13.Selected.Value),
    Notify(
        "Please select a Service Subcategory.",
        NotificationType.Error
    ),

    DataCardValue13.Selected.Value = "Parking Request" &&
    IsBlank(FacilitiesParkingLocationDropdown_1.Selected.Value),
    Notify(
        "Please select a Parking Location.",
        NotificationType.Error
    ),

    DataCardValue13.Selected.Value = "Building Maintenance" &&
    IsBlank(FacilitiesRequestTypeDropdown_1.Selected.Value),
    Notify(
        "Please select a Request Type.",
        NotificationType.Error
    ),

    SubmitForm(FacilitiesRequestForm_1)
)

ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString:
Set(varShowSubmitErrors, true);

If(
    IsBlank(FacilitiesServiceSubcategoryDropdown_1.Selected.Value),
    Notify(
        "Please select a Service Subcategory.",
        NotificationType.Error
    ),

    FacilitiesServiceSubcategoryDropdown_1.Selected.Value = "Parking Request" &&
    IsBlank(FacilitiesParkingLocationDropdown_1.Selected.Value),
    Notify(
        "Please select a Parking Location.",
        NotificationType.Error
    ),

    FacilitiesServiceSubcategoryDropdown_1.Selected.Value = "Building Maintenance" &&
    IsBlank(FacilitiesRequestTypeDropdown_1.Selected.Value),
    Notify(
        "Please select a Request Type.",
        NotificationType.Error
    ),

    SubmitForm(FacilitiesRequestForm_1)
)
